jvto-navy-forensic.note: Declared for /verify-jvto; zero call sites outside website.css as of 2026-09-04.

jvto-orange-ink.note: AA-safe text variant: 5.50:1 on white, 5.05:1 on canvas.

jvto-gold.note: Declared, zero call sites outside website.css.

jvto-gold-ink.note: AA-safe pairing for jvto-gold (5.54:1 white / 5.08:1 canvas); zero call sites.

jvto-wa-green.note: Presumably intended for a WhatsApp CTA; zero call sites outside website.css.

jvto-ink-soft.note: Only 1 call site as of 2026-09-04 — thin adoption, not dead.

jvto-rule.note: Declared, zero call sites outside website.css.

jvto-on-navy.note: Declared for copy/chrome on navy; zero call sites — components on navy currently use text-white or Tailwind slate/emerald/amber/red directly.

jvto-status-normal.note: Declared status ladder not wired to VolcanicStatusBadge.tsx, which uses raw Tailwind emerald/amber/red instead.

jvto-status-advisory.note: No matching state exists in VolcanicStatusBadge's STATUS_CONFIG at all.

jvto-status-unknown.note: No matching state exists in VolcanicStatusBadge's STATUS_CONFIG at all.

sans.purpose: Body copy, form controls, default UI text. Variable weight (no fixed weight array) so font-medium through font-black resolve to real cuts.

display.purpose: Editorial headings, prices, stat numbers, review quotes.

mono.purpose: UI chrome: labels, keys, section numbers, badges, footers, credential/verification data. Never narrative prose.

shadows.name: jvto-soft
shadows.purpose: Softer ambient card shadow (v2 elevation variant).

shadows.name: jvto-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Newer hover variant, deliberately named apart from jvto-hover to avoid collision.

motion.name: default-transition
motion.purpose: Tailwind's default transition timing, redeclared unlayered in website.css to out-cascade a TipTap :root * { transition: none } injection.

motion.name: dest-card-expand
motion.purpose: flex-grow and border-radius on .dest-card hover — the one deliberate exception to 'never animate layout properties'.

components.name: Button — primary
components.description: Default action variant. bg-jvto-lime, text-jvto-navy. Hover is a hardcoded #8Cb82b — a leftover v1 hex, not jvto-lime-ink. Flagged in DESIGN.md, not fixed here.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; border-radius: 2px; background-color: #8CC63F; color: #0D1B2A; padding: 12px 24px; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #8Cb82b; }

components.name: Button — secondary
components.description: bg-jvto-navy, white text. Hover bg-gray-800 (stock Tailwind, not a jvto token).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: #0D1B2A; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 2px; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #1f2937; }

components.name: Card — .card-jvto
components.description: Flat at rest. Fill jvto-off or white, border jvto-border, radius one of 16px/20px/32px chosen per context. Shadow + transform transition to --shadow-jvto-hover over 500ms.
components.css: .card-jvto { background-color: #F6F5F2; border: 1px solid #E3E0DA; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(13,27,42,0.10); transition: box-shadow 500ms ease, transform 500ms ease; } .card-jvto:hover { box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -12px rgba(13,27,42,0.15); }

components.name: Volcanic Status Badge
components.description: Business-domain status chip (operational / restricted / closed). Currently uses raw Tailwind emerald-950/amber-950/red-950, not the jvto-status-* ladder. advisory and unknown states declared in the theme have no matching UI state.
components.css: .ds-status-operational { background-color: #022c22; border: 1px solid #065f46; } .ds-status-restricted { background-color: #451a03; border: 1px solid #92400e; } .ds-status-closed { background-color: #450a0a; border: 1px solid #991b1b; }

narrative.northStar: Three surfaces, three jobs — navy for authority, lime for action, orange for warmth
narrative.overview: v2 replaces a single-signal-color v1 system (near-black obsidian, one phosphor-lime, single-font Inter) that had drifted out of the codebase while its DESIGN.md kept describing it. v2 is documented here directly from the shipped theme: website.css's @theme block, layout.tsx's font wiring, and grep counts against src/. Roughly a third of the declared theme tokens (jvto-gold, jvto-wa-green, the five-state status ladder, jvto-rule, jvto-on-navy*) have zero real call sites — they are legitimate reserved tokens, not dead weight, but should not be presented as load-bearing system rules until something actually uses them.
keyCharacteristics: Three-surface color system: navy (authority), lime (primary action), orange (secondary accent)
Three-typeface split by job: Inter body, Raleway display, JetBrains Mono chrome — not a single weight axis
Seven CSS custom-property shadows, not Tailwind's default shadow scale
Two coexisting radius conventions: stock Tailwind (2px/full) plus arbitrary card values (16/20/32px); a declared 12/18/28/40 scale exists but is unadopted
About a third of declared color tokens are reserved/unadopted, not dead — tracked explicitly rather than silently forgotten
One deliberate exception to 'never animate layout properties': .dest-card's hover flex-grow expansion

rules.name: Three fonts, three jobs, not three choices
rules.body: Inter is body copy and controls, Raleway is editorial display, JetBrains Mono is chrome and credential data. The split is by job, never by taste.

rules.name: Reserved tokens are not the palette
rules.body: jvto-gold, jvto-wa-green, jvto-rule, jvto-on-navy*, and the status ladder are declared but unadopted. Confirm intent before treating them as the system in new work.

rules.name: No invented font-size ramp
rules.body: The real type scale is Tailwind's stock text-xs through text-7xl. v1's custom clamp() ramp did not carry forward and should not be reintroduced without evidence.

rules.name: TipTap purple stays in (cms)
rules.body: --tt-brand-color-* must never appear on public-facing surfaces. Carried forward unchanged from v1.

dos: Do use jvto-lime only for primary action affordances — it is the one color reserved for 'go.'
Do use jvto-orange for secondary accents and meta glyphs, paired with --shadow-jvto-orange on circular buttons.
Do keep the three-typeface split by job.
Do reuse one of the seven radii already in DESIGN.md's frontmatter rather than introducing an eighth.
donts: Don't hardcode a lime-family hex as a hover state — UI/Button.tsx:39 already leaked v1's #8Cb82b this way.
Don't treat reserved/unadopted tokens as the live palette without confirming intent.
Don't invent a custom font-size ramp.
Don't animate layout properties except .dest-card's one deliberate exception.
